'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
***[[2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire]]
****An agreement to [[ceasefire|pause fighting]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] for four days enters into effect at 7am. [https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2023/11/24/israel-hamas-truce-comes-into-effect-how-it-could-now-unfold (Al Jazeera)]
****On the first day of the ceasefire [[Hamas]] releases 13 [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[hostage]]s, some of whom are [[dual citizen]]s, while [[Israel]] releases 39 [[Palestinian prisoners]] as part of the ceasefire agreement. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/24/middleeast/israel-hamas-hostage-release-deal-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/qatar-confirms-that-red-cross-has-received-24-hostages-from-gaza/ (''Times of Israel'')]
****Hamas releases one [[Filipinos|Filipino]] and 10 [[Thai people|Thai]] hostages as part of a separate deal with the [[Thai government]] which was [[broker]]ed by [[Iran]]. [https://time.com/6339450/hamas-releases-thai-hostages/ (''Time'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/qatar-confirms-that-red-cross-has-received-24-hostages-from-gaza/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Observing the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas, [[Hezbollah]] stops all its military operations which also prompted the IDF to stop the shelling of [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/video/20231126-en-nw-grab-rawad-taha-from-7h-gnignati-rebecca  (France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Somalia]] is admitted as the 8th member of the [[East African Community]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67522844 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**The security chief for [[El Chapo]]'s [[Sinaloa Cartel]] Nestor Isidro Pérez Salas, also known as "El Nini", is arrested in [[Culiacán]], [[Sinaloa]], [[Mexico]]. The [[United States]] [[Drug Enforcement Administration]] had a [[United States dollar|$]]3 million [[Bounty (reward)|bounty]] for El Nini's arrest. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/el-nini-arrested-alleged-security-chieff-el-chapo-sons-mexico-psychopath/ (CBS News)]
*[[Bangladesh Police|Bangladeshi police]] intercept and detain 58 [[Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh|Rohingya refugees]] attempting to travel to [[Indonesia]] by boat, citing risks of [[Human trafficking in Indonesia|human trafficking]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/rohingya-refugees-bangladesh-sail-indonesia-stop-3945531 (AFP via CNA)]
*[[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian President]] [[Daniel Noboa]] repeals the [[Ecuador|country]]'s ten-year policy permitting possession of small drug quantities in an effort to curb "micro-[[Illegal drug trade|trafficking]]". [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/11/25/23/ecuador-president-orders-reversal-of-drug-decriminalization (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Montenegro]] approves the [[extradition]] of [[South Korea]]n [[cryptocurrency]] entrepreneur [[Do Kwon]], as requested by South Korea and the [[United States]], following the collapse of Kwon's company [[Terra (blockchain)|Terraform Labs]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/montenegro-court-approves-extradition-cryptocurrency-king-do-kwon-2023-11-24/ (Reuters)]
